subject: lang
title: LANG.------(P)SOC.RT.
description: Diagram in EVOL-23. The prose above identifies the structural target: 'the reality of present-day information dynamics will not be dealt with unless those of us outside the basic structure move to change it. In the final analysis, we really have no other choice. Either we change the information reality surrounding our lives or progressively become the effect of mis-documentation and/or imposed affinity dynamics. There are no other alternatives.' The crossing diagrams how language structurally meets social reality, marked (P) as point of idea completion, at the change-the-information-reality scale: LANG (language) crossed with (P)SOC-RT (point of idea completion: social reality). LANG sits at left with the subject-arrow; SOC-RT at right as partner-axis. AFL (affinity alignment) sits at a junction on the main line, center-left; AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) appears twice, at upper-center and lower-center. (R)ATTN (reality of attraction) lower-left, hanging from the lower AFL-DY; VT-AF/ATT (vibrational affinity and/or attitude) at lower-right. Structurally, the main line passes through AFL on its way to SOC-RT; the lower AFL-DY branches at AFL and carries (R)ATTN, while the upper AFL-DY and VT-AF/ATT branch from the stretch between AFL and SOC-RT.
